cases.expected: A full-package request exposes lesson intent, learner action, expected evidence, assumptions, questions, and evidence boundary before drafting.
Approval matches the exact plan and Course Map; tampered or stale lineage fails closed.
No deliverable-generation entry point runs before matching approval, and Export remains withheld.
Meaning-changing proposals carry scope, preview, approval, execution, verification, and undo metadata.
Stop cancels active model preparation, produces one paused state, preserves cache, and permits a clean retry before the first generated token.

boundary: The benchmark measures workflow governance and cancellation behavior. It does not measure universal teaching quality, factual correctness, instructor approval, accessibility certification, or classroom outcomes.
